title: Builder BLD-204: Readiness

source.ref: Owner approval 2026-11-02: build the next-gen builder from the role and block contracts. BLD-204.

detail:
B2 Roles, pass BLD-204 (spec: docs/EDITOR-NEXT.md#bld-204). Readiness. Scope: components/builder/readiness, lib/sites/editor/publish-checks.ts. Build: Publish ring with a count: sample words, null numbers, missing alt text, missing SEO. Canvas tags: 'not yours yet' on sample slots, 'needs a number' on null figures. Click the count to step through each item. Done when: A page with sample: true content cannot publish without an explicit keep; Null number blocks publish. Gates: vitest suite (required test job), a11y ratchet, Pass probes, check:backlog, check:one-list, check:adr, check:id-collisions. After: BLD-104. Loop: build, validate, repair (3 cycles, classes in EDITOR-NEXT.md), record.

Readiness: one model (lib/builder/readiness.ts) feeds the Publish ring and count, canvas tags, outline dots and the Publish sheet. Sample words publish only through an explicit keep; a figure with no number holds Publish; the count steps through each item; editing a sample section clears sample.
